# Express Analytics

> > AI-powered analytics and customer intelligence platform delivering data-driven insights through agentic AI, marketing automation, and voice-of-customer solutions.

Express Analytics is a comprehensive data analytics company offering AI-driven solutions for customer intelligence, marketing optimization, and enterprise analytics. The company specializes in agentic AI workflows, customer lifetime value modeling, and omnichannel retail analytics with products like ActiveVoice AI and VOCA.

## Key Topics

- Agentic AI
- Customer Analytics
- Marketing Analytics
- ActiveVoice AI
- Customer Lifetime Value (CLV)
- Data Visualization
- Voice of Customer (VOCA)
- Customer Segmentation
- Campaign Optimization
- Churn Prediction
- Data Cleansing
- AI-Powered Solutions
- Business Intelligence
- Marketing Automation
- Enterprise Analytics

## Core Solutions & Services

- [Agentic AI for Marketers](https://www.expressanalytics.com/agentic-ai): Agentic AI marketing solution with kAInet and Google Ads integration for campaign automation
- [Customer Analytics Services](https://www.expressanalytics.com/services/customer-analytics): Customer analytics service featuring CLV modeling and segmentation for buyer insights
- [Marketing Analytics Solutions](https://www.expressanalytics.com/services/marketing-analytics): Marketing analytics platform for campaign optimization, ROI tracking, and attribution analysis
- [Voice of Customer Analytics](https://www.expressanalytics.com/solutions/voice-of-customer-analytics): VOCA product for sentiment analysis, social listening, and NLP-powered customer feedback
- [Data Visualization Services](https://www.expressanalytics.com/services/data-visualization): Data visualization service with drag-and-drop dashboards for real-time business reporting
- [Data Cleansing Services](https://www.expressanalytics.com/services/data-cleaning-services): Data cleaning service for quality assurance, standardization, and error correction
- [All Services Overview](https://www.expressanalytics.com/all-services): Complete services overview including customer analytics, marketing, and AI-powered solutions
